assertions.name: phi8_universal_M7_across_all_10_pairs
assertions.source: PR #1625 Track 1 mechanism doc; level-2 SU(2) Wenzl annihilator.

description: Φ_8 universality probe across ALL 10 distinct pair-differences (X − Y) with X, Y ∈ {p, n, D, ³He, ⁴He}. For each pair, compute Δa_m = a_m(X) − a_m(Y), build the prefix sums S_M = Σ_{m=0..M} Δa_m·(u;u)_m, factor over ℤ[u], and identify M_first_Φ_8 — the smallest M at which Φ_8(u) = u^4 + 1 first divides S_M. Prediction (per PR #1625 Track 1 + Wenzl-annihilator mechanism): M_first_Φ_8 = 7 universally. The (n − p) isospin-doublet pair additionally scans (u²−1) = Φ_1·Φ_2 multiplicity to verify coexistence with the PR #1579 doublet factor.

data.verdict: CONFIRMED: M_first_Φ_8 = 7 universally across all 10 pairs
